sentences.en: The largest recipient of Japan's ODA that year was China.
sentences.zh: 那一年，中国是日本官方发展援助的最大接受国。

sentences.en: Grateful recipients included a number of area food banks and charities.
sentences.zh: 感激的接受者包括了多个地区的食物银行和慈善机构。

sentences.en: What a strange message! There is no sender and no recipients either.
sentences.zh: 这信息真奇怪！既没有发送方也没有接收方。

senses.zh: <正式>接受者，领受者；接收器，容器
